scopeLabel: City of Miami single-family homes + Miami-area listing archive
sourceQuery: CANCEL_FLAG = 'N' AND REFERENCE_ONLY_FLAG = 'N' AND DOR_CODE_CUR >= '0100' AND DOR_CODE_CUR < '0200' AND TRUE_SITE_CITY = 'MIAMI'
notes: County coverage includes all disclosed single-family records returned for City of Miami, municipality 01, at retrieval.
The listing archive also includes addresses elsewhere in Miami-Dade. The countywide single-family set is larger than this collection.
County aerial photographs are cached as regional image tiles and centered on each parcel. Image capture dates vary.
Front exterior photographs and photographer drone galleries are available only for verified source matches.
Nearby-school names are available where supplied in the listing archive. They do not establish school assignment or Buggy service availability.
County assessed values and recorded transfers retain their source years. They do not establish current asking price or active listing status.
